$description: RichText (platform/components/RichText): its component tokens (its links, inline code and quotes use the link, code and blockquote tokens).

rich-text-text.$description: RichText: the text color of prose.

rich-text-article-font-size.$description: RichText: the size of article text (a page of reading).

rich-text-article-line-height.$description: RichText: the line height of article text.

rich-text-article-measure.$description: RichText: the reading width of an article (about 80 characters).

rich-text-article-gap.$description: RichText: the space between the blocks of an article.

rich-text-article-heading-gap.$description: RichText: the space above a heading in an article.

rich-text-compact-font-size.$description: RichText: the size of compact text (notes, comments, help in a panel).

rich-text-compact-line-height.$description: RichText: the line height of compact text.

rich-text-compact-gap.$description: RichText: the space between the blocks of compact text.

rich-text-compact-heading-gap.$description: RichText: the space above a heading in compact text.

rich-text-h1-font-size.$description: RichText: the size of a first-level heading.

rich-text-h1-line-height.$description: RichText: the line height of a first-level heading.

rich-text-h2-font-size.$description: RichText: the size of a second-level heading.

rich-text-h2-line-height.$description: RichText: the line height of a second-level heading.

rich-text-h3-font-size.$description: RichText: the size of a third-level heading.

rich-text-h3-line-height.$description: RichText: the line height of a third-level heading (a fourth level takes the text’s size).

rich-text-strong-font-weight.$description: RichText: the weight of strong text.

rich-text-list-indent.$description: RichText: the indent of a list, where its markers sit.

rich-text-list-item-gap.$description: RichText: the space between list items.

rich-text-marker-text.$description: RichText: the color of list markers.

rich-text-pre-background.$description: RichText: the fill of a code block.

rich-text-pre-text.$description: RichText: the text color of a code block.

rich-text-pre-font-family.$description: RichText: the code font of a code block.

rich-text-pre-font-size.$description: RichText: the size of a code block’s code.

rich-text-pre-line-height.$description: RichText: the line height of a code block.

rich-text-pre-padding.$description: RichText: the space inside a code block.

rich-text-pre-radius.$description: RichText: the corners of a code block.

rich-text-pre-focus-outline-color.$description: RichText: the focus ring of a code block that scrolls (keyboard focus).

rich-text-rule-color.$description: RichText: the color of a rule (hr) between parts.

rich-text-rule-width.$description: RichText: the width of a rule.

rich-text-caption-text.$description: RichText: the color of a figure’s caption.

rich-text-caption-font-size.$description: RichText: the size of a figure’s caption.

rich-text-image-radius.$description: RichText: the corners of a picture in prose.

rich-text-image-max-width.$description: RichText: a picture never wider than its column.

rich-text-task-gap.$description: RichText task list: the space between an item's checkbox and its text (the checkbox row's gap).

rich-text-table-background.$description: RichText table: the Plenix table's surface.

rich-text-table-text.$description: RichText table: the Plenix table's text color.

rich-text-table-line.$description: RichText table: the full inside lines and the frame (the Plenix table's line color).

rich-text-table-line-width.$description: RichText table: the width of its lines (the Plenix table's).

rich-text-table-header-background.$description: RichText table: the header cells' fill (the Plenix table header).

rich-text-table-header-text.$description: RichText table: the header cells' text (the Plenix table header).

rich-text-table-header-font-weight.$description: RichText table: the header cells' weight (the Plenix table header).

rich-text-table-cell-padding-inline.$description: RichText table: a cell's side padding (the Plenix table's).

rich-text-table-cell-padding-block.$description: RichText table: the space above and below a cell's text.

rich-text-table-cell-min-width.$description: RichText table: the narrowest a column gets (room to click into an empty cell).
